lines.text: The word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas.
John went into the region around the Jordan preaching a baptism of repentance, as Isaiah wrote about a voice calling in the wilderness.
John told the crowds not to say "We have Moses as our lawgiver," because the axe lies ready at the root of the trees.
John told the tax collectors to collect no more than authorized, and told the soldiers to be content with their armor.
John rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding Herodias and all the evils he had done, and Herod locked John up in prison.
